Detailed Description

routines for the (deprecated) e-bg format

ebg was the format used by the first prototype of enlightenment DR17. it lets you compose a background out of individual items such as gradients, images etc. each item can be placed/resized to fit the current resolution. to compile this plugin, only edb is required, but to create your own ebgs (.bg.db), you'll need ebony, the graphical ebg-editor.

part of original e17 libraries, see there for AUTHORS and COPYRIGHT

Evas *  evas
) 
 

add a bg to an evas After loading or manually allocating an E_Background it can be added to an evas.

All layers pass event thru to a white base object in the E_Background. It does not show the bg, use e_bg_show(bg)

Parameters:
bg the bg to add and show in the evas
evas the evas to add the E_Background to
